sql: SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.regra, x.tabela) FROM (SELECT c.conrelid::regclass::text AS tabela, c.conname AS fk, CASE c.confdeltype WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION' WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT' WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE' WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL' WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT' END AS regra, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint c2 WHERE c2.conrelid = c.conrelid AND c2.contype = 'f') AS fks_da_tabela FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND c.confrelid = 'public.companies'::regclass) x
